headline: HuyenBao v11.30 — mogul.huyenbao.com giờ là domain riêng cho ADMIN dashboard (mở trang chủ → thẳng bảng điều khiển quản trị)
summary: ADMIN-FIRST DOMAIN. mogul.huyenbao.com is now dedicated to the game-management console: opening the root URL lands you straight on /admin (302 via the new Next.js 16 src/proxy.ts, host-aware), /api/* social + admin endpoints are untouched, and the full game (with the SQLite social backend) remains playable at /game as an escape hatch. The admin footer's 'Về game' link now points to /game when browsed on the mogul domain and to / everywhere else. Any other host — huyenbao.com, localhost, LAN IP, dev — is completely unaffected. The proxy file uses the Next 16 proxy.ts convention (replaces deprecated middleware.ts) and is automatically skipped by the static GitHub Pages build because that build's pageExtensions only include .tsx.
features: mogul.huyenbao.com/ → 302 → /admin — the admin console IS the front door of the domain
NEW src/proxy.ts (Next 16 proxy convention, host-based): mogul host root → /admin, mogul /game → rewrite to the game, every other host untouched
ESCAPE HATCH: /game serves the full game with the SQLite social backend on the mogul domain
Admin footer 'Về game' link is domain-aware (/game on mogul, / elsewhere)
STATIC-SAFE: proxy.ts is a .ts file and the GitHub Pages build only enables .tsx page extensions → silently excluded
deploy/ README now documents the URL map (/, /admin, /game, /api/*); Caddy + nginx configs annotated (Host header must be preserved)
Version bumped to v11.30 at FRONT of app name
